title: Web Console Documentation
description: Documentation contract for the web-console scenario, retrofitted to the react-vite template v1.0.0 contract.

contract.extensionRule: Every durable scenario document is registered here. Use docs/concepts/ for product and system concepts, docs/guides/ for task procedures, docs/reference/ for stable lookup material, docs/internal/ for developer and agent memory, docs/operations/ for runtime operations, docs/business/ for commercial strategy, and docs/domains/<domain>/ for domain-specific depth that would overload DOMAINS.md.

sections.title: Getting Started
sections.description: First-touch experience, scenario identity, and local startup flow
sections.purpose: Help users, operators, developers, and agents understand what the scenario is, where to begin, and how to run it.
sections.extensionPolicy: Add only entrypoint-level documents here. Task-specific procedures belong in guides; durable architecture or product concepts belong in concepts.

documents.title: README
documents.description: Top-level scenario summary and primary human entrypoint

documents.description: First implementation session and template-adoption status

documents.title: Quickstart

sections.title: Concepts
sections.description: Durable product and system mental models
sections.purpose: Document how the scenario is put together, what capabilities it owns, and which concepts guide future code changes.
sections.extensionPolicy: Add durable concept docs here when they describe cross-cutting product/system ideas. Put deep domain-specific material under docs/domains/<domain>/ once a domain outgrows the central domain map.

documents.title: Architecture
documents.description: System map: surfaces, contracts, boundaries, shared infrastructure

documents.description: Bounded contexts, product capabilities, ownership, and source paths

documents.title: Glossary

documents.title: Flows
documents.description: User/system workflows, lifecycle states, transitions, retries, cancellation, stale-completion risks, and checked formal model status
documents.condition: Required once a real domain has lifecycle states, retries, cancellation, stale-completion risk, or formal workflow invariants. Web-console has these via PTY sessions and voice streaming; FLOWS.md should be authored in the temporal-flows batch.

documents.title: Data
documents.description: Data ownership, persistence, retention, migrations, import/export, and privacy-relevant data behavior

documents.title: Integrations

sections.description: Commercial strategy, packaging, pricing hypotheses, channels, and validation

sections.extensionPolicy: Add business docs for durable market, packaging, pricing, channel, or validation strategy.

documents.title: Monetization
documents.description: Revenue role, packaging, pricing hypothesis, cost drivers, and validation plan
documents.condition: Required when the scenario is evaluated as a product, SKU component, add-on, or service accelerator.

documents.title: Go To Market
documents.description: Launch strategy, target channels, positioning, and validation experiments
documents.condition: Required when the scenario has a market-facing use case or monetization hypothesis.

sections.title: Operations
sections.description: Deployment, runbooks, observability, and runtime readiness
sections.purpose: Document how the scenario runs beyond a code edit.
sections.extensionPolicy: Add operations docs for production procedures, backup/restore, support playbooks, telemetry, incident response, or tier-specific deployment notes.

documents.description: Supported delivery tiers, packaging assumptions, runtime dependencies, and readiness status

sections.title: Guides
sections.purpose: Explain repeatable procedures that are too operational for concepts and too narrative for reference material.
sections.extensionPolicy: Add a guide when a user, operator, developer, or agent needs step-by-step instructions for a recurring task.
